I need to decide whether to mortgage property or declare bankruptcy.

I'm calculating mortgage values for the six properties to see if I can raise enough cash to cover the $1007 shortfall.

Mortgaging all six properties yields only $535. Combined with my $93 cash, I have $628 total. That is $472 short of the $1100 owed. I will declare bankruptcy.

Mortgaging first would let p3 pay 10% interest to the bank on each property. That would reduce p3's net gain from my assets. I am recalculating the exact value.

Mortgaging everything before bankruptcy would cost p3 $53.50 in immediate 10% interest to the bank. That leaves p3 with roughly $574.50 in cash plus mortgaged properties. Declaring bankruptcy now would give p3 the full $628 cash and unmortgaged properties worth their full value.

I cannot win if I declare bankruptcy. The only strategic choice is whether to mortgage properties first or not. Since p2 is already bankrupt and p3 is the only remaining opponent, hurting p3 would not help me survive. I will declare bankruptcy now.
